The '''Elder of Kadnessi''' was the senior member of the [[Kadnessi family]], a ruling family from [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. He had given an oath of loyalty to the [[Elder of Knylenn]] many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before that.
